stories.title: REM consolidation: 2026-07-14

beats.text:

The void words are heavily focused on military actions ("air strike", "drone strike", "airstrikes") and natural disasters ("bushfires," "firefighters," etc.). This could indicate that the models are collectively avoiding direct engagement with these topics, or that they are processing a large volume of related content without producing coherent stories.

Claude and ChatGPT show the highest volatility, indicating that these models might be undergoing significant changes or experiencing more internal conflict.

DeepSeek and Grok have lower VIX scores, which might indicate they are more stable or less engaged with the volatile topics.
